sources.name: ZZPdock
sources.poll_method: GET the IT category page; broker-deduplicated feed; filter client-side by lane keywords.
sources.notes: Aggregates freelance/ZZP assignments from 27 Dutch brokers in one deduplicated feed; free, no login; 242 live IT assignments with DevOps engineers among the most-requested profiles. Verified 3-0 by adversarial panel.

sources.name: Circle8
sources.poll_method: Browse the public assignments board in the browser (bot-checkpoint blocks plain HTTP); use the zelfstandig-professional filter.
sources.notes: Major Dutch broker; board is publicly browsable in a real browser (80 live assignments, zelfstandig-professional filter) but sessionless HTTP hits a Vercel bot checkpoint (429). Verified 3-0/2-0 by adversarial panel.

sources.name: Opdracht Overheid
sources.poll_method: Browse the ICT filter in the browser; listings render client-side; detail pages carry rate and closing date.
sources.notes: Dutch aggregator of interim/freelance/zzp assignments at government bodies; sessionless view shows filters but listings render client-side — browser lane; research fetches saw rich public detail pages (rate, closing date).

sources.name: ICTjob.be
sources.poll_method: Search IT jobs in the browser; sessionless requests time out.
sources.notes: Belgium's specialist IT job board, carrying freelance and contract IT roles; both sessionless probes timed out (tool-level block), so verification completes in the browser lane at rebuild.

sources.name: Jobs.lu
sources.poll_method: GET the board; browse the IT / Programming category; filter client-side.
sources.notes: Luxembourg national job board; listings and categories browsable without an account; applying needs a login, searching does not.

sources.name: Striive
sources.poll_method: GET the public assignments surface and filter Dutch IT and engineering contracts.
sources.notes: The public assignments page rendered with real Dutch listings and an IT Development category showing 188 open roles, with no login wall required for browsing.

sources.name: DevITJobs Netherlands
sources.poll_method: GET the public DevOps results and filter remote, city, and technology.
sources.notes: Sessionless HTTP GET was blocked with a 403 Forbidden on both the DevOps listings endpoint and the plain homepage, consistent with bot protection rather than an account requirement.

sources.name: Nationale Vacaturebank
sources.poll_method: GET the public occupation results and filter location, contract type, and freshness.
sources.notes: Both the DevOps search page and the bare homepage returned a hard WebFetch failure ("unable to fetch") with no HTML at all, so this is treated as a sessionless access wall pending browser-lane confirmation, since it is a long-established Dutch national board that plausibly still runs bot mitigation rather than being dead.

sources.name: EU Remote Jobs
sources.poll_method: GET the public board and filter Europe or EMEA technical roles client-side.
sources.notes: Sessionless HTTP GET was blocked with a 403 Forbidden on the endpoint (already the plain homepage), consistent with bot protection rather than a login wall, so it moves to the browser lane.

sources.name: Jobgether
sources.poll_method: GET the public search surface and filter Europe, remote type, contract, and occupation.
sources.notes: Sessionless HTTP GET returned 403 Forbidden on both attempts against the homepage, indicating bot protection, so the browser lane is needed to verify the previously observed Europe DevOps listings.

sources.name: No Fluff Jobs
sources.poll_method: GET the public board and filter DevOps, system administration, remote, and B2B roles.
sources.notes: WebFetch was unable to retrieve nofluffjobs.com on two attempts (a tool-level block rather than a normal HTTP response), so verification requires the browser lane.

sources.name: Wellfound Europe
sources.poll_method: GET the public Europe results and filter role, contract, and remote eligibility.
sources.notes: The Europe-specific endpoint 403'd and the plain-homepage fallback rendered only marketing copy and category navigation links with zero job titles, so this is effectively a gated/empty shell for sessionless access.

sources.name: Remote in Europe
sources.poll_method: GET the public board and filter DevOps/SysAdmin and contract roles.
sources.notes: The homepage rendered fully with current DevOps and infrastructure listings and no login wall, confirming it as a directly admissible European remote board.

sources.name: JobServe
sources.poll_method: GET the public search and select IT, Contract, remote, rate, and freshness filters.
sources.notes: Two separate fetches of the search page and the homepage both came back with no server-rendered body at all, consistent with a JS-only shell or silent bot mitigation rather than a genuinely dead site, so it is routed to the browser lane rather than dropped.

sources.name: CWJobs Contract
sources.poll_method: GET the public contract results and filter occupation, rate, location, and remote.
sources.notes: The DevOps contract search timed out at 60 seconds and the bare homepage then timed out with ETIMEDOUT, which reads as connection-level bot mitigation on a well-known StepStone-owned UK board rather than the site being dead, so it is routed to the browser lane.

sources.name: Computer Futures Netherlands
sources.poll_method: GET the public Netherlands results and filter Cloud and DevOps contract roles.
sources.notes: Both the jobs listing URL and the plain homepage were rejected with HTTP 403, a clear bot-block on an active SThree-brand recruitment site rather than a login requirement, so it is routed to the browser lane.

sources.name: Hays Netherlands
sources.poll_method: GET the public Netherlands search and filter technology, interim, ZZP, and location.
sources.notes: Both the job-search URL and the plain homepage were rejected with HTTP 403, a clear bot-block on a major, active recruitment firm rather than a login requirement, so it is routed to the browser lane.

sources.name: RED Global
sources.poll_method: GET the public jobs page and filter Cloud and Infrastructure, Europe, remote, and contract.
sources.notes: This sessionless probe returned HTTP 200 with real server-rendered listings and no login or captcha wall, which contradicts the cited 2026-07-14 prior observation of an access wall; the jobs page skews heavily SAP/Business-Applications/Software-Development, with only one Cloud & Infrastructure listing and no DevOps, Linux, SRE, or Platform Engineering tagged roles, so lane relevance is weak.

sources.name: Contra
sources.poll_method: Open the official Opportunities surface in signed-in Chrome; the user owns all authentication.
sources.notes: The opportunities page is a client-rendered shell with no listings in the raw HTML, and its own product marketing confirms the full feed needs a signed-in account, so it is routed to the browser lane rather than dropped.

sources.name: Upwork
sources.poll_method: Open Find Work in signed-in Chrome and filter remote DevOps contracts; the user owns all authentication.
sources.notes: WebFetch received a 403 Forbidden on both the find-work URL and the plain homepage, consistent with bot-blocking on a well-established, real freelance marketplace; retains catalogued auth-required status and flips to the browser lane.

sources.name: Freelancer
sources.poll_method: Open the jobs surface in signed-in Chrome and filter DevOps projects; the user owns all authentication.
sources.notes: The public jobs and jobs/devops/ surfaces rendered real, current listings with budgets and bid counts sessionlessly with no login wall encountered; an account is only needed to bid, so the browse surface is admitted while auth_required stays true for participation.

sources.name: FlexJobs
sources.poll_method: Open the member search in signed-in Chrome and filter EU-eligible DevOps roles; the user owns all authentication.
sources.notes: Three separate WebFetch attempts across the DevOps search URL and the plain homepage all timed out, consistent with anti-scraping protection on this well-known membership-paywalled aggregator; catalogued auth-required status is retained and it flips to the browser lane.

sources.name: Remote.co Developer Jobs
sources.poll_method: GET the public developer board and retain only roles explicitly open in EU countries.
sources.notes: Two separate WebFetch attempts on the developer board and the homepage both timed out with no content returned, which reads as bot-blocking rather than a login wall on this well-established remote-jobs board, so it flips to the browser lane pending re-check.

sources.name: Built In Remote
sources.poll_method: GET the public remote board and retain only roles tied to its EU country searches.
sources.notes: The site is real and reachable and the general remote board shows current listings, but the /dev-ops-engineering and /dev-ops-engineering/netherlands filter paths kept serving the same unfiltered generic sample rather than server-rendered DevOps results, implying client-side JS filtering is required, so it flips to the browser lane for accurate targeting.

sources.name: Working Nomads DevOps
sources.poll_method: GET the public DevOps board and filter Europe or an explicit EU country.
sources.notes: The page is real (correct title and nav for a DevOps jobs page and claims of 30K+ daily-updated remote jobs) but is an empty JS shell sessionlessly with zero listings server-rendered, so it flips to the browser lane.

sources.name: Himalayas Netherlands
sources.poll_method: GET the public Netherlands results and filter occupation, engagement, and freshness.
sources.notes: The Netherlands country page itself is real and server-rendered (3,376 jobs claimed) but its current top-of-feed sample skewed to React Native, QA, and backend roles with no DevOps titles; the sibling role-filtered devops-engineer search on the same site confirmed a real, current, EU-based DevOps listing sessionlessly, so the board is admitted overall.
